verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is an equity and cap-table management SaaS, and a SaaS platform could plausibly embed an AI assistant that acts as an MCP client, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows no AI assistant, no MCP client support, and no way to connect external tool servers. The only integrations documented are Gusto data sync and third-party 409A providers, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
